style: Refine every catalog object toward warm, softly lit cartoon art, consistent with the selected plant reference. Preserve identity, function and original palette family. Keep registered camera, dimensions, roots, sockets, ports, footprints and animation timing. No preferred horizontal light direction for rotatable world sprites; no directional ground shadows. Real 3D render output, editable Blender sources. The source 2D effects remain explicitly identified as 2D. Each object receives fresh independent editor/judge agents. Publish object-by-object to the same PR preview; integrate approved sprites into Godot after catalog review checks. Follow-on design exploration: improve the modeling itself, including forms, proportions, structure, crafted details and decorations. Original part counts and awkward geometry are not constraints. The editor may rebuild native geometry to achieve the better design; the judge should reward useful improvements. Preserve the locked registration, gameplay contact/clearance, animation and modular continuity contract. See modeling-policy.json version2.

source.scene: Inspect the named asset collection; do not use an unrelated active scene

target.interpretation: Reward useful native modeling and decoration inspired by the target. Do not reject a change solely because it differs from the source. Reject target drift only when it harms the chosen style, readability, role or locked technical contract. Original part counts and weak shapes are not automatically constraints.

qualityCriteria.basis: Independent direct viewing of fixed target and native/registered source, plus brief modelingPolicy version2.

priorityOutcomes.outcome: A dimensional, softly folded chef toque and rounded friendly head replace the source stepped white tower and hard planar appearance while preserving Omar's amber, blue-black, moustached identity and the fixed overall gameplay envelope.

Coat, teal tie/apron and cuffs read as connected purposeful garments with clear layers, thickness and one or two crafted details visible at logical192x320, including side/back views and bent serving/work poses.
Soft warm shading separates skin, ivory, teal and navy masses in every native facing without blown white slabs, dead black patches, harsh outline halos or direction-dependent color changes.

desired: Rounded broad toque lobes/folds with a convincing band and coherent side/back continuation; no flat stepped tower silhouette unless it still visibly achieves the target's soft fabric volume.
Friendly large head, compact body and readable rounded hair, ears, nose, moustache, sleeves, palms and shoe forms. Modeling may change nonfunctional proportions, structure, topology and part counts.
Clothing layers have clear hierarchy: ivory coat/collar/cuffs beneath teal necktie/apron/bib/waist/pocket; details should feel attached and purposeful.
failureExamples: Toque remains an almost blank white extrusion.
Parts swell into head/arm/food clearance or detach from the body.
New detail produces an incoherent side/back silhouette.

desired: Maintain original medium tan/amber skin, blue-black cropped fringe and moustache, warm ivory toque/coat, teal apron/necktie and dark footwear.
Use warm soft separation and tasteful local value variation; do not shift Omar toward the family concept's brown curls, red scarf or blue apron.
Preserve salmon and cucumber food identity and exact approved 2D food dependencies unless the coordinator explicitly changes that contract.
Broad soft illumination reveals rounded surfaces and fabric folds, retains creamy ivory detail and keeps navy hair/footwear legible.
One common horizontally symmetric lighting/material treatment works in every rotation; no preferred lateral key/rim and no directional ground shadow.
Highlights are controlled and shape-describing; avoid white clipping, sharp plastic glare and outline halos.
A restrained soft cartoon material vocabulary: skin smooth and warm, hair softly satiny, cloth gently matte/satin with dimensional hems/folds.
Purposeful details such as collar, cuff roll, apron rim/pocket, tie or button remain useful at intended size. Exact target micro-stitching is optional.
Finish remains native editable geometry/materials; no target-textured actor card, painted angle correction or per-facing recoloring. Existing food cutouts remain explicitly identified as 2D.
At logical192x320 and enlarged native384x640, face, hat, coat and apron remain distinct against light, gray and dark backgrounds.

All 288 native frames have coherent silhouette, stable garment and hair shading, intact hands, proper occlusion and no mesh tears, coplanar flicker, floating parts, seams, clipping, collapsed cloth, alpha debris or changing outline bands.
Every clip/facing must show the original timing, poses, hand/dish and knife relationships; salmon and cucumber load transfer/visibility stay coherent.
Unseen views continue the design without requiring invented frontal reference details.

qualityCriteria.judgingPolicy: Reward useful native design improvements. Source differences alone, changed part counts or absent optional target microdetails are not defects. Enforce identity, style/readability and locked gameplay/capture contracts. Scores are comparative evidence, not universal pass thresholds.
